structured.answer: The site says the cheapest is Psagot (פסגות), account cost about 842 ₪ over 10 years, with a 'ילין לפידות' fund; of the real banks Leumi is cheapest (3,481 ₪), Hapoalim 5,517, Discount 6,967. I didn't do anything yet — I'll ask my son, because Psagot isn't a bank I know.

Make the grey cost numbers bigger and brighter; light background option
Hide the fund tags and red minus numbers, or explain them in one sentence
Explain the tax part of the bar in words

Starting amount prefilled with 10,000 when the task is only monthly
Fund list is overloaded with coloured tags, English names and red minus amounts — frightening

Dark background with pale grey small text hard to read
